args: repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); mcp="$repo_root/packages/mcp/bin/kibi-mcp"; if [ ! -f "$mcp" ] || [ ! -d "$repo_root/packages/mcp/dist" ]; then common=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir); repo_root="$(cd "$common/.." && pwd)"; mcp="$repo_root/packages/mcp/bin/kibi-mcp"; fi; exec bun run "$mcp" --diagnostic-mode
